items.item:
7. A Customer's name and an access request text with spaces around them are
   stored as written; a room name, a Customer's name and an access request
   text of spaces only are each refused and nothing changes.
   Shows A02-1, A02-2, A02-3. [witness: verification:registry_a02_required_texts_blank_refused_padded_kept]
statements: missing(v) <=> v is absent or strip(v) = ""   -- A02-1
for every stored required value v: not missing(v)   -- A02-2
stored(v) = given(v) whenever not missing(v)   -- A02-3

verdicts.why: The check detects whitespace-only room names, customer names, and request texts as missing, verifies no state change, and verifies padded customer and request text are stored verbatim. It does not test A02-1's absent-value branch or A02-3 for every non-missing required value, so the named invariants are only partially asserted as stated.
